name: PufferGo | 外贸独立站AI建站专家 | AI Website Builder for Export
author: puffergo

sections.description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Search for PufferGo in WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New, or manually upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/puffergo.
  2. Activate PufferGo in the Plugins page.
  3. Go to the PufferGo settings page to connect your account and start building.
sections.faq:
Is PufferGo free to use?

Yes, we offer a free tier that’s enough to create a complete website. More advanced features are available with paid plans.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. We’ve eliminated all technical barriers, and top-tier AI models from both China and the US are here to assist you. If you run into any issues, feel free to contact us—we’re happy to help. Of course, if you do have technical skills, you’ll find it even smoother to use, but the difference isn’t huge.

How does it help with SEO?

We generate Tailwind HTML code that’s extremely clean and loads incredibly fast. Unlike traditional website builders (like Elementor), there’s no bloated, redundant code.

Where is the data stored?

Only your account-related data is stored on our cloud servers. All other data remains on your own server.
sections.changelog:
0.24.0

  • Five New Ready-to-Use Components — Added an “About Us” alternating text-and-image story block, a cinematic full-bleed company story section, a four-point “factory tour” showcase, a four-point after-sales service block, and a full-screen hero with top-left copy — giving you more ways to tell your factory or company story and showcase your service commitments without custom coding.
  • Redesigned Section Style Panel — Reworked how you style a section’s background, spacing and content width: the panel now works consistently for both plain sections and component-driven ones (sliders, FAQ blocks, feature grids), so your background and layout choices stick instead of resetting when you edit the component’s content.
  • Heading Level Control — You can now set a text block’s heading tag (H1 through H6) directly in the editor, with built-in guardrails against pages ending up with multiple H1s or overused H3s — better structure for both readers and Google SEO.
  • Faster Component Search — The components panel now supports search, so finding the right block in a growing library takes seconds instead of scrolling.
  • More Reliable SEO Content — Fixed a rendering issue where certain collapsible or conditional content was invisible to search engine crawlers, ensuring Google can see and index everything a visitor sees.
  • Smoother Language & Update Experience — The site’s default content-generation language no longer silently follows your admin dashboard language, thumbnail previews for image fields display more clearly, and updates now automatically clear cached content so you always see your latest changes without extra steps.
  • General Reliability Pass — Fixed silent rendering failures across dozens of components, tightened mobile spacing across the entire component library, and resolved several smaller styling and build issues.

0.24.0 (中文版)

  • 新增 5 个即用型组件 — 新增「关于我们」图文交替故事区、电影感通栏公司故事区、四件套工厂实力展示、四点位售后服务组件，以及左上角文案的全屏首屏组件，无需自己写代码就能讲好工厂/企业故事、展示服务承诺。
  • 区块样式面板重新设计 — 重做了区块背景、间距、内容宽度的编辑方式，普通区块和配置型组件（轮播图、FAQ、功能网格等）现在体验一致，改内容不会再把背景/布局设置悄悄冲掉。
  • 标题层级可控 — 文字区块现在可以直接在编辑器里设置标题标签（H1~H6），并内置了防呆机制，避免一个页面出现多个 H1 或滥用 H3，页面结构和 Google SEO 表现更好。
  • 组件面板支持搜索 — 组件库越来越大，现在可以直接搜索找到想要的组件，不用再一页页翻。
  • 修复部分内容对搜索引擎不可见的问题 — 修复了部分折叠/条件展示内容爬虫抓不到的问题，确保 Google 能看到并收录访客能看到的全部内容。
  • 语言与更新体验优化 — 站点默认生成语言不再跟随后台语言变化、图片字段缩略图显示更清晰，插件更新后会自动清一次缓存，改动即时生效不用手动清缓存。
  • 整体稳定性提升 — 修复了数十个组件的静默失效问题，收紧了组件库在移动端的竖向留白，并修复了若干构建与样式细节问题。

0.23.0

  • Choose Your Site’s Content Width — Pages used to be locked to a 1280px content area, which can feel cramped on today’s larger screens. You can now pick 1280, 1440, or 1600 in the Design System panel, and the whole site — headers, footers, blog, product pages and the component library — follows your choice instantly. New sites default to the roomier 1600.
  • Set the Background of Any Section — Sections built from configurable components (sliders, FAQ, feature grids and the like) can now have their background colour, padding and content width adjusted, just like ordinary sections. Previously these settings quietly reverted every time you edited the component’s content.
  • A Simpler Style Panel — The section style panel no longer asks you to tell apart the “root” and “container” elements before you can change anything. It now shows what you are editing on a single line, followed by one set of controls, and puts content width alongside background where you would expect to find it.
  • No More Controls That Silently Disappear — When a setting genuinely does not apply — a full-bleed slider has no content width to adjust, for instance — the panel now says so instead of hiding the control and leaving you wondering whether something is broken.
  • Tighter Spacing on Mobile — Vertical padding in the component library was too generous on phones, pushing content off the first screen. Spacing has been tightened across 130 components; desktop rhythm is largely unchanged.

0.23.0 (中文版)

  • 整站内容宽度可以自己选了 — 以前页面内容区固定在 1280px，在现在的大屏幕上显得局促。现在可以在设计系统面板里选 1280、1440 或 1600，页头、页尾、博客、产品页和组件库整站跟着变，立即生效。新站点默认用更开阔的 1600。
  • 区块背景色终于能设了 — 用可配置组件搭的区块（轮播、FAQ、特性网格这类），现在可以像普通区块一样调背景色、留白和内容宽度。以前每次编辑组件内容，这些设置都会被悄悄还原。
  • 区块样式面板更简单了 — 改样式前不用再分辨「根元素」和「容器元素」了。面板顶部一行告诉你正在改的是哪块，下面就是一组控件；内容宽度也挪到了背景旁边，找起来更顺手。
  • 不再有凭空消失的开关 — 某个设置确实用不上时（比如通栏轮播本来就没有内容宽度可调），面板会直接说明原因，而不是把开关藏起来让你怀疑是不是坏了。
  • 手机上的留白收紧了 — 组件库的上下留白在手机上偏大，首屏装不下多少内容。130 个组件统一收紧了留白，电脑端的节奏基本不变。

0.22.0

  • Multi-Level Product Categories, Done Right — If your product catalog has three or more levels of categories, the breadcrumb trail now shows the full path (Products → Parent Category → Subcategory → …) instead of stopping one level short, and category pages correctly show their subcategories even when a middle-tier category has no products directly in it.
  • New Full-Bleed Banner for Your Product Page — The Product listing page can now use the same full-width image banner style as your Blog page, with a title, description, and breadcrumb trail. It can be switched on or off from the template settings, so you can keep the simpler text-only header if you prefer.
  • 6 New Page-Building Components — Added a fullbleed photo section with stats for About pages, an OEM/ODM customization capability grid, two new product catalog layouts (category tiles and photo cards), and two more “Why Choose Us” layouts (icon grid and split image with checklist).
  • New Components Now Show Up Faster After Updates — Component lists were sometimes cached for up to 24 hours after an update, so newly added components could take a while to appear. Updates now refresh the list automatically.

0.22.0 (中文版)

  • 三级及以上产品分类导航更完整 — 如果你的产品分类做到了三级或以上，面包屑现在会显示完整路径（产品 → 父分类 → 子分类 → …），不会只显示到中间就断掉；分类页也能正确展示子分类，哪怕中间那一级分类自己没有直接挂产品。
  • 产品列表页新增通栏大图横幅 — 产品列表页现在可以跟博客页一样使用通栏大图横幅，带标题、简介和面包屑，可以在模板设置里一键开关，喜欢原来纯文字横幅的话也可以保持不变。
  • 新增 6 个页面组件 — 关于我们通栏大图+数据统计区块、OEM/ODM 定制能力展示区、2 个新产品目录版式（分类图片磁贴、实拍图产品卡片网格）、2 个新”为什么选择我们”版式（图标宫格、分栏图文清单）。
  • 更新后新组件出现得更快了 — 之前组件列表最长会缓存 24 小时，刚上线的新组件可能要等一阵才看得到，现在更新后会自动刷新。

0.21.0

  • A Certifications Wall That Actually Shows Off Your Credentials — The certifications section was rebuilt to run edge-to-edge across the page instead of squeezing certificates into narrow columns. Each certificate now displays in a proper A4 frame at full aspect ratio (nothing cropped, so seals and stamps stay intact), and visitors can click any one to view it enlarged. Cards show just the essentials — badge, title, and issuing body — with certificate numbers available in the enlarged view. If you have many certificates, the section automatically shows two full rows and tucks the rest behind a “show all” button, so it never overwhelms the page. Fully keyboard-navigable for accessibility compliance.
  • Fixed Broken Styling Across the Component Library — Fixed a build issue that was silently dropping certain style rules, which left 17 places across the library rendering incorrectly — missing gradient backgrounds on testimonial sections, wrong map heights on contact forms, and misaligned column widths in several layouts. All are now correct. Note: sections you generated before this update keep their original styling; regenerating or editing a section applies the fix.
  • Faster Component Browsing — All component preview images were converted to WebP, cutting their total size by roughly 80%. The component picker now loads noticeably faster, especially on slower connections.

0.21.0 (中文版)

  • 资质证书墙全面重做，实力展示更有分量 — 证书区块从原来挤在窄栏里改成整页通栏铺开，每张证书按标准 A4 比例完整裱框展示（不裁切，钢印、公章都完整保留），访客点击任意一张即可放大查看。卡片上只保留最关键的三项——徽章、证书名称、颁发机构，证书编号放在放大视图里查看。证书数量多也不怕：区块会自动铺满两行，其余收在「查看全部」按钮后面，不会把页面撑得太长。同时支持完整键盘操作，符合无障碍规范。
  • 修复组件库中多处样式失效 — 修复了一个构建环节静默丢弃样式规则的问题，此前导致组件库中 17 处渲染异常——客户评价区块的渐变背景消失、询盘表单的地图高度不对、多个版式的分栏宽度错位等，现已全部恢复正常。注意：本次更新之前已生成的区块仍保持原样式，重新生成或编辑该区块即可应用修复。
  • 组件浏览速度提升 — 全部组件预览图转为 WebP 格式，总体积缩减约 80%，组件选择面板的加载明显更快，网络较慢时提升尤其明显。

0.20.13

  • More Consistent Section Widths Across Your Whole Site — Fine-tuned how section widths line up across every page, so all your content now shares the same clean, aligned edges — giving your site a more polished, professional look wherever visitors land, including pages built before this update.
  • Facebook Pixel + Privacy-Compliant Cookie Consent — Add a Facebook Pixel ID in Settings to track ad conversions and build better-optimized ad audiences. A tasteful consent notice now appears whenever Pixel or Google Analytics is enabled, so tracking only starts after a visitor opts in — keeping your site aligned with GDPR and similar privacy laws, which builds visitor trust and helps protect your ad accounts from compliance issues.

0.20.13 (中文版)

  • 全站区块宽度更统一 — 精细调整了各页面区块的宽度对齐方式，让全站内容的边缘保持一致、整齐划一，不管访客落到哪个页面，看到的都是更专业、更精致的观感——这次更新之前搭建好的页面也会一并受益。
  • 新增 Facebook Pixel 支持 + 隐私合规 Cookie 同意提示 — 可以在设置里填入 Facebook Pixel ID，追踪广告转化效果、沉淀更精准的广告受众。开启 Pixel 或 Google Analytics 后，访客会看到一个得体的同意提示，只有主动同意才会开始追踪——这让你的网站符合 GDPR 等隐私法规要求，既能提升访客对网站的信任感，也有助于避免广告账户因合规问题被风控。

0.20.12

  • More Consistent, Professional-Looking Page Sections — Cleaned up inconsistent width and spacing across the component library so sections line up cleanly when combined on a page, instead of some looking wider or narrower than their neighbors. Also fixed a few sections (like the certifications wall and industry solutions grid) that could render with an unbounded background or crowd items too far apart.
  • Richer Google Search Snippets for Company Info — Search engines can now pick up more complete company details (founding year, team size, regions served, certifications, address, phone, email) straight from your site profile to enrich how your business appears in search results — only filling in gaps you haven’t already set manually, and working correctly across multilingual sites.

0.20.12 (中文版)

  • 页面组件排版更统一、更专业 — 整理了组件库里各区块宽度、间距不统一的问题，同一页面里堆叠多个区块时左右边缘能对齐，不会再出现忽宽忽窄的观感；同时修复了资质证书墙、行业解决方案这类区块可能出现背景铺不满或内容挤在一起的问题。
  • 公司信息在 Google 搜索结果中展示更完整 — 站点画像里的成立年份、团队规模、覆盖地区、资质认证、地址、电话、邮箱等信息，现在能自动喂给搜索引擎，让公司信息在搜索结果中呈现更丰富；只会补全你还没手动填写的空白项，不会覆盖已有内容，多语言站点也能正确适配。

0.20.11

  • Smarter Language Redirect for Multilingual Sites — Visitors whose browser language differs from your site’s default now get automatically taken to the matching translated page (or the translated home page on your front page) — no forced redirect, and never away from a specific page unless a real translation exists for it, so search visitors landing on untranslated content stay right where they are.

0.20.11 (中文版)

  • 多语言站点智能语言跳转 — 访客浏览器语言与站点默认语言不一致时，会自动带去对应的译文页面（首页则跳到对应语言首页）；不会强制乱跳，只有在这篇内容确实有译文时才会跳转，否则访客会留在他们本来点进来看的内容上，不会被莫名带走。

0.20.10

  • Polylang Manual Install Fallback — If one-click installing Polylang fails (some hosts block outbound plugin downloads), you now get a direct link to WordPress’s own “Install Plugin” screen as a working fallback, plus a reminder so you’re not tempted to keep retrying the automatic button.
  • Bugfix — Category names and breadcrumbs on Solution / Case Study / Testimonial pages now correctly resolve the current language’s translated term instead of occasionally showing the wrong language.

0.20.10 (中文版)

  • Polylang 手动安装兜底 — 一键安装 Polylang 失败时（部分主机会拦截插件下载的出站请求），现在会提供一个直达 WordPress 自带”安装插件”页面的链接作为备选方案，并提示不要再反复点击自动安装按钮。
  • 问题修复 — 解决方案 / 案例 / 客户证言页面的分类名称和面包屑导航现在会正确读取当前语言的翻译词条，不再偶发显示错误语言。

0.20.9

  • Contact Form Safeguard — Added a site-wide daily cap on contact form submissions (100 per day by default). If your site is ever targeted by automated spam or bot traffic, submissions beyond the daily limit are automatically rejected instead of piling up in your database, and you’ll get an email alert the first time the limit is hit each day.

0.20.9 (中文版)

  • 询盘表单防护升级 — 联系表单新增全站每日提交上限（默认每天 100 条）。一旦站点被恶意脚本或机器人集中攻击，超出当日上限的提交会被自动拒绝，不会持续灌入数据库；当天首次触发上限时还会给你发一封提醒邮件，方便及时发现异常。

0.20.8

  • Batch AI Translation — A new Translate Center lets you select multiple pages, posts, products, solutions, or case studies and translate them into another language in one run, with progress tracking and per-item retry.
  • Translation Context — AI translation now uses your business context (industry, tone, brand name) plus your own optional instructions, applied automatically to every AI translation — batch, single-page, navigation menu, and string translation alike — for more accurate, on-brand results.
  • Fixed Category Translation Corruption — Translating a shared category into a second or third language could previously overwrite an already-correct translation in another language, leaving breadcrumbs and category labels showing the wrong language. Fixed, and existing affected data repaired.
  • Fixed Debug-Mode Login Failures — Sites with WP_DEBUG enabled could fail to log in due to a shared-slug check running too early; fixed.

0.20.8 (中文版)

  • 批量 AI 翻译 — 全新翻译中心，可一次选中多个页面、文章、产品、解决方案或案例，批量翻译成另一种语言，支持进度追踪与单条失败重试。
  • 翻译上下文 — AI 翻译现在会自动结合你的业务信息（行业、语气、品牌名）以及可选的翻译说明，应用到批量翻译、单页翻译、导航菜单翻译、字符串翻译的每一次调用，让翻译结果更准确、更贴合品牌调性。
  • 修复分类翻译数据错乱 — 此前将共享分类翻译成第二、第三种语言时，可能会覆盖其他语言已经正确的翻译，导致面包屑和分类标签显示错误语言。现已修复，并修复了受影响的历史数据。
  • 修复调试模式下无法登录 — 开启 WP_DEBUG 的站点可能因共享 slug 检测过早触发而登录失败，现已修复。

0.20.7

  • Shared URL Slugs Across Languages — Translated pages and categories can now reuse the same slug (e.g. /about/ and /zh/about/) without Polylang Pro, keeping URLs clean and consistent for SEO across markets.
  • Language URLs Stay Put — Fixed an issue where visiting a translated page with a language prefix could redirect back to the default-language URL, so visitors land on the correct language version.
  • AI Translations Inherit Source Slugs — When PufferGo AI creates a translation, it keeps the original page and category slug instead of appending language suffixes like -zh.

0.20.7 (中文版)

  • 多语言共享 URL 别名 — 无需 Polylang Pro，翻译后的页面和分类可复用相同 slug（如 /about/ 与 /zh/about/），各语言 URL 结构统一，更利于 SEO。
  • 语言前缀 URL 不再被重定向 — 修复访问带语言前缀的翻译页时被跳回默认语言地址的问题，访客能稳定停留在当前语言版本。
  • AI 翻译继承源 slug — PufferGo AI 创建翻译时，页面和分类会保留原文 slug，不再自动追加 -zh 等语言后缀。

0.20.6

  • More Languages for Visitor-Facing Pages — Added a lightweight frontend language pack for 12 locales, giving international visitors translated interface text without loading the full admin translation catalog.
  • Reliable Multilingual Navigation — Header, footer, breadcrumb, menu, and content links now resolve to the current language, including clean language-code home URLs.
  • Correct Product Category Switching — Language switching on product category archives now opens the matching translated category instead of sending visitors to the homepage.
  • Safer Translation Relationships — Product and other PufferGo taxonomy translations now preserve every existing language when a new translation is added.

0.20.6 (中文版)

  • 访客前台支持更多语言 — 新增覆盖 12 个地区的轻量级前台语言包，无需加载整套后台翻译，即可为海外访客显示本地化界面文字。
  • 多语言导航更可靠 — Header、Footer、面包屑、菜单和正文内链会自动指向当前语言，并统一使用简洁的语言代码首页地址。

  • Product Category Filtering — The product listing page now has a category tree sidebar for drill-down browsing instead of a flat pill bar. Each category shows a live product count (de-duplicated and rolled up from sub-categories, so a parent reflects everything beneath it), an arrow marks branches you can expand, and on mobile the filters tuck neatly into a slide-out drawer. All links are shareable, back-button friendly, and SEO-clean.
  • Easier Product Browsing — In the List view, the entire product card is now clickable — not just the image — so visitors reach product details with far less precision required.
  • Related Products on Detail Pages — Each product page now shows a “Related Products” row beneath the inquiry form, keeping visitors engaged with more of your range if they don’t inquire right away. Recommendations start with items in the same category, fall back to sibling categories, and are ranked by name similarity so same-series models surface first — all fully automatic, no setup.
  • Rendering Reliability — Fixed several front-end display issues with configurable (Alpine-powered) blocks, including cases where site-wide generated components could not be edited or rendered incorrectly.

0.12.0 (中文版)

  • 三级导航菜单 — 头部菜单现支持最多三级，产品线和解决方案多也能层次分明。全宽（巨幕）头部把子分类排成分栏，普通头部用侧滑面板，移动端则自动折叠成清爽的缩进手风琴。菜单项与产品分类还新增了「描述」字段，让巨幕布局呈现更丰富的卡片式条目。
  • 产品分类筛选 — 产品列表页由原来的一排扁平分类胶囊，升级为可逐级下钻的左侧分类树。每个分类带实时产品数量（跨子分类去重汇总，父级能真实反映其下全部产品），可展开的分支有箭头提示，移动端筛选收进侧边抽屉。所有链接可分享、可后退、对 SEO 友好。
  • 产品浏览更顺手 — 列表视图下，整张产品卡片任意位置都可点击进入详情，不再只有图片可点，访客不用精准点图也能轻松打开。
  • 详情页相关产品推荐 — 每个产品详情页在询盘表单下方新增「相关产品」一行：优先催促访客询盘，若暂不询盘，再用相关产品继续留住他。推荐先取同分类产品，不够则取兄弟分类，并按名称相似度排序，让同系列型号自动排在最前——全程自动，无需任何配置。
  • 渲染稳定性 — 修复了配置型（Alpine 驱动）区块的多处前端显示问题，包括整站生成的组件无法配置、以及个别渲染异常的情况。

0.11.3

  • AI HTML Import Fix — Resolved a styling issue when importing AI-generated HTML from third-party tools, ensuring imported pages display correctly on the front end.

short_description: AI website builder built for export. Quickly create high-converting B2B brand sites optimized for Google SEO.
description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
